correctness.rationale: Exact intersection-array proof: n=2k+2, antipodal perfect matching, n-4 empty support coverage, adjacent pair has 2k-2-a1 external neighbors and distance-two pair has 2k-mu. Under 3<=mu<=k-2 both are inadequate. Icosahedral mu=2 equality is excluded by the verified 30-pair residual adjacency lemma. Both standalone checkers reproduce 36 and 100 optima and no weight<4 solutions.
